redaction_policy: No request/response headers, cookies, authentication state, or signed redirect URLs were collected. Credential query values, the public RE-Bench archive password, public AWS EXAMPLE fixtures and credential-related example literals were omitted from retained bodies. Ancillary contact email values, obfuscated contact addresses and mailto targets were omitted. Simulated trajectory/example addresses were also omitted without classifying them as actual personal contacts. Benchmark identities, numeric fields, configurations, costs and trial data are unchanged. Original fetched and retained SHA-256 hashes distinguish sanitized evidence. Raw bodies and downloaded attachments are not published.
